constraint_types.interpretation: Upper bound on the QP translational velocity command; not a proof about measured physical speed.
Upper bound on consecutive QP translational command change divided by control dt; not measured base acceleration.
Upper bound on the QP angular velocity command; physical tracking is evaluated separately.
Extra margin outside the measured transport circle in the admitted static map and local QP; close table docking uses separate known geometry/contact gates.
Upper bound on QP joint velocity commands; measured velocity has a separate runtime monitor and stated numerical tolerance.
Upper bound on consecutive QP joint velocity command change divided by control dt; not measured joint acceleration.

constraint_policy.status: Software admission/design ranges, not validated RB-Y1 velocity, acceleration, braking, clearance, or safety ratings.
constraint_policy.executor_rule: LLM constraints can tighten applicable limits. The executor must also impose the current model limits, collision checks, sensor/TF freshness and stop policy; these cannot be removed by a task specification. A valid specification is not execution or safety validation.
